audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits 51.96% over 612 games: Zed owns the poke and first-item window, Swain flips at two items — the content prose states this shape cleanly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart read 'Skill' at Level 3, Levels 4-5, First item and 2+ items while content win[2]/[3]/[5]/[6] and the packet say Zed / Zed / Zed / Swain.
audit.why: His E (5s) + W (20s) poke-and-retreat outcycles Swain's Q; Eclipse/Youmuu's is his peak; two items flips to Swain's drain vs his front-loaded single-target burst.
audit.corrected: Four full-layer sides moved with matching whys and ratings; content already agreed so sides edited alone per the chart rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; the untargetable R-dash nuance and the W-downtime all-in window were absent from the cooldowns field; two copy-paste-bleed bullets.
audit.why: Kit: R Death Mark 120/110/100 with a 3s mark, dash is untargetable; W Living Shadow 20/19/18/17/16; Q 6s, 75 energy at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Real numbers and the no-shadow-no-escape window written into breakdown.cooldowns; bleed bullets rewritten to their titles.

edits.before: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Nevermove has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Zed Death Mark: 120s at rank 1 with a 3s detonation — root him AFTER the untargetable dash ends, while he weaves damage. - W Living Shadow is 20s at rank 1: no shadow, no escape — that is your all-in window. - His Q costs 75 energy: dodges starve him.

edits.before: E his step-up, passive-pull the root for the chunk + heal, Q the retreat — every landed root is a won trade with a health refund attached.
edits.after: Vision of Empire's 5500+ range covers side lanes from mid — when he vanishes, drop W on his roam path and the reveal buys your team a Flash.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 like the demon is already online — Swain without R is a slow mage with a dream and a root on cooldown.
edits.after: He W-swaps back through your wave the moment you overextend — chasing past the river hands his shadows a free re-engage.

edits.before: W completes the setup: vision + slow from across the map. Root-into-W never misses, and the passive soul fragments heal you.
edits.after: His E-Q-W poke-and-retreat cycles faster than your Q comes back — hold E for his shadow return, not for the poke war.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-spam stops costing the lane. Poke the wave contact and pull every rooted target with the passive.
edits.after: He pokes you down and controls the wave through 4-5 — give ground, bank HP and mana, and wait for the two-item flip.

edits.before: Liandry's spike: the drain outpaces their damage in any extended fight. Force rivers, root the entry, ascend, profit.
edits.after: Eclipse or Youmuu's is his peak solo-kill window — buy HP and MR so Death Mark stops one-shotting, then punish the failed dive.

edits.before: Late Swain is the anti-team: flank-root their engage, ascend in their backline, and demonflare the clump that forms around you.
edits.after: Two items in you flip it: his burst is front-loaded and single-target while your drain, W zone and R uptime win every long fight.
